_comment: The owner-identifier gate's per-repo lists: config files to read for account names, and local-data files allowed to hold an identifier, each with a reason.

localDataReasons.LICENSE: The copyright line names the product, Account Planning Tool, which is also the neutral author name on every commit, so the gate reads it as an owner identifier.
localDataReasons.README.md: It names the product, Account Planning Tool, which is also the neutral author name on every commit, so the gate reads the product name as an owner identifier.
localDataReasons.index.html: It names the product, Account Planning Tool, which is also the neutral author name on every commit, so the gate reads the product name as an owner identifier.
